scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Nongeneric composite-step modular translations with gcd(n,q)>1; explicit piecewise affine maps and their finite Markov graph.
scientific_integrity.prior_work: Coprime case is already covered elsewhere and is expressly not claimed; classical interval spectral methods credited.
scientific_integrity.proof: Direct orbit decomposition, block determinant, periodic interval identity, formal graph zeta and Markov lap entropy argument.
scientific_limitations: No extension to arbitrary cyclic or noncyclic permutations or perturbations.
The rational graph zeta is not the physical Artin–Mazur zeta.
Finite checker cannot replace general argument.

title: Periodic interval continua and cyclotomic entropy factors at noncoprime modular steps
